lines.en: Day & time:\nSaturday — 6:42 AM
With her first kiss in the books and her best friend only mildly traumatized, stocks in Tsukasa Tsukioka’s virginity had rapidly soared to a new all-time high.

With estimates showing that it’s still undervalued, though, there was much more time for her to run the share price up before the impending rug-pull when her self-preservational instincts kick in and she realizes that maybe it isn’t best to learn how sex works from an adult male who her own mother informed her was attracted to her.
For now, though, she had two things — her overflowing curiosity and an extremely mature and well-informed older sister.
And if anyone was going to be able to actually help Tsukasa right now, it would almost assuredly be her.
: Mnh...Tsukasa?...
: Good morning, Onee-sama. You don’t look scary at all right now.
: It’s not even 7:00 AM yet...
: I can come back at a later time if that is more convenient for you.
: A later- no. Just...what is it? What’s wrong?
: I was just wondering if you could teach me how to masturbate.
: I’m guessing that’s a no.
: Mother! You’re awake. Good morning. You look radiant as ever today.
: Tsukasa? What are you doing out of bed so early? Your lesson on royal cutlery etiquette doesn’t start for another two hours. And your “sailing and rowing” class isn’t for another four.
: I was just-
: Then, after that, you have Spanish.
: Lo sé. Sin embargo, tengo una pregunta.
: ¿Qué es?
: So, you know how you said that Jeeves made an accurate assessment in being attracted to me and that he thinks I’m the cutest girl he’s ever laid his eyes-
: Shh! Tsukasa, that isn’t something you can be saying out loud! What have I told you about speaking with sexual undertones in front of the help?!
: To keep it in the pleasure wing. But none of us ever go there and whenever I try, everybody just walks away and pretends they don’t see me.
: Well, whatever it is, can it wait until after your lessons? I have to bring Yuki to the doctor’s office this morning and can’t help you right now.
: I canceled my lessons today because I feel like it’s important for me to practice masturbating, but I can’t figure it out and need help.
: Oh. I see. Well, have you asked your sister?
: Yes, and she shut the door on me after making me stand there for a full minute! Does she not understand how precious my time is?!
: Have Akira show you, then. It’s not like he ever does anything.
: Mother, no! If Jeeves is attracted to me, which he very well should be, it’s important that I maintain a distinguished and civilized guise in his presence!
: I worry that may make him like you less, dear.
: If this is truly urgent, surely there’s someone else you know who could help you with it?
: But I barely even know anybody.
: Darling, you’re a Tsukioka. Surely there’s someone.
: You want me to what?
: Teach me how to masturbate.
: Miss, this is a taco stand.
: If you use a chair, does that make it a taco sit?
Needless to say, things weren’t going all that well for Tsukasa this morning. It was barely 9:00 AM and she had already asked three people about masturbation and ridden on a train. Twice.
So now, here she was — back in her room to try her hand (pun unintended) at self-pleasure once more. Just this time, she’d be doing it with an audience.
: Okay! Listen up, you pathetic inbred whelps.
: There comes a time in every little girl’s life where she must grow up. She must become a woman. And, despite what Chinami or anybody else may have told you, that time for me is now.
: So what we’re going to do, as a team, is decide which one of you gets to have sexual intercourse with me. Understood?
: Now, the first order of business is- wait a second! What happened to Super Sonic Jalapeno Meltdown Catastrophe Nine?! Trixie?! You were supposed to be keeping an eye on him!
: I’m sorry, Tsukasa! I tried to- NO EXCUSES! As the senior most member of the Plush-pal Armada, it is your responsibility to make sure everyone shows up on time.
: So, as punishment for your actions, you will not be chosen to have sexual intercourse with me today. Which works out because you are also a girl and I think I need to try a boy for stuff this time.
: Which means it comes down to either Tank, Glockenspiel, Cantaloupe, or Steve. I will now hear your cases. Please keep them as concise and professional as possible.
: I’m unworthy, princess Tsukasa! There’s nothing I could possible say to make you choose me! Right you are, Tank! But your honesty is admirable, so I’ll think about it.
: I know I’m the smallest, but size isn’t everything! After all, you’re- SILENCE!
: If you understood anything about my potential suitors, you’d understand that they’re all going to be bigger than me! Which means any PIPSQUEAKS like you are out of the question! Next!
: Cantaloupe HATES the Jews!
: CANTALOUPE! Go wash your mouth out with soap right this instant! Antisemitism will NOT be tolerated in this household!
: That leaves just you, Steve. What do you have to say for yourself? Why should I choose you over Tank or Pipsqueak? I mean Glockenspiel.

: Because dragons have been around since the dawn of time! Which means I have far more experience than somebody like Tank could ever have as a weird red alien guy. Oh yeah? You have experience? With who?
: I served in King Arthur’s ninth battalion and managed his own personal brothel in which I tested the merchandise for- AHAH! Referring to women as merchandise?! Unacceptable!
: Which I guess leaves you, Tank. Congratulations on eking out a victory simply because you acknowledged how far out of your league I am. What’s about to happen is a privilege. Do not forget that.

: The question now is exactly how we’re going to do this, though. They don’t make plushes with penises attached to them. At least as far as I know. So we’ll just have to imagine you have one, I guess.

: I’m sorry in advance if I hurt you. But I suppose doing so will make it easier to accept it when the time comes for me to be on the other end of such a large size differential. And that time is coming soon, Tank.

: I told you what Mother said about Jeeves, right? How he can’t keep his eyes off of me and has been drowning in temptation this whole time? I knew it! Just imagine if Cantaloupe had that level of restraint.
: Anyway, lie down like that while I get on top of you and try to figure this out. Apparently, this method works well for other girls who can’t “get off” by using their fingers.
: I think there are adult toys too, but I tried looking them up and none of them seem very fun. You don’t mind if I wear my underwear right? It seems unsanitary not to.
: Yes, princess Tsukasa! Any amount of attention from you at all is- um...
: Well, I...
: I think I’m just gonna...start now, so...be quiet and...try not to interrupt me.
: Mm...mmh...mm!
: Oh, yes! Oh, that feels...well, not much like anything yet. But for the sake of the experiment, let’s say it feels good! Ah! Tank! You’re so big and strong!
Share prices continue to soar as the young girl experimentally grinds herself against a plush toy she’d owned since long before these thoughts ever assailed her.

And while it didn’t feel much like anything yet, it’s not like it felt bad either. Just awkward. She couldn’t help but keep her eyes open. Or feel like she was violating some sort of sacred bond between girl and alien.
But when she closed her eyes, and imagined someone else there, someone who I’m sure you’re already thinking of as well — that’s when the feelings hit.

It was something she couldn’t do when she was experimenting with her fingers. But, having spent so long ascribing personalities to the cotton crowd who looked on at her cowgirl tryouts made it seem more real.

Her movements became more passionate as she dragged herself harder against the toy, focusing mainly on a single button on its belly that felt good when it clipped her just right. So she kept doing that.
So much so, in fact, that she ultimately tore the button clean off and was left frantically searching for something else that could make her feel good again.
That’s when it finally hit. That instinctual urge to fill a certain void within her. That sinking feeling that she’d feel more full with a true partner. With a specific partner. With Jeeves.
The tone shifts entirely. She likes it. This is real. It all suddenly makes sense.

But also it doesn’t. Yet it does. And it doesn’t and does and doesn’t and does but she can’t explain it and can’t think of anything but the button and his face and his button and the void within her, desperate to be treated like a REAL princess but also CLAIMED like property!

Like SHE was claiming something now! In control in the most carnal way possible, yet reversing roles internally while different systems deeper down had her firing on all cylinders at the thought of even DEEPER systems.
The kind that cause insanity and screaming and all of THAT made sense now too since if THIS felt THAT good then HOW would it feel once THE VOID HAS BEEN FILLED?
: Haaah!
She thought of Chika. Not intentionally. But it was a thought that came up.
Of the noises that cool older girl made through the walls as she and Chinami listened in confused but also not because she gets it now but it’s STILL kind of confusing since this is ALL confusing.
Then she thought of the teacher. The other one. How she, too, had fallen victim to the pleasures of the flesh just feet away from where Tsukasa was now.
She could see it. Smell it. What was that? So intoxicating and terrifying all at once.

She thought of everyone. Everything. And for a moment, the world had spiraled into utter chaos where NO thought would stick for more than just a second or two. What was happening to her? Was she broken?
: Aaah! That...aah...aaaaah!

She was broken. She was definitely broken. Something was breaking. Something was going to break. But she wanted to break it. Snap it. Destroy it. KILL IT. She just needed to PUSH. HARDER. DEEPER. SHE’S RIGHT THERE. She’s GROWING UP.
: I can’t...I...aaaah...
Then she suddenly stops. After just a few seconds in the first of seven rings of ecstasy.
Because, despite having rarely been told “no” in her life, what she was doing now felt like something she wasn’t allowed to do. Like it was wrong, but she couldn’t explain why.

So she laid there for a few minutes. Feeling guilty. Feeling gross. Feeling strangely and uncomfortably wet. Pressing her thighs together because, weirdly enough, that felt kind of good too but not the kind that made her want to explode.

She couldn’t bring herself to look at Tank, but knew that he was staring directly at her — furious that she would so violently tear a piece of him off for good in the throes of fiery, curious passion.
It was something Tsukasa would inevitably feel soon enough as well.
Perhaps...
Even sooner than one might think.
The phone felt colossal in her hand. But it would be nothing compared to what she’d feel like in his.

She thumbs the name she gave him like he’s some sort of pet. But it’s less because she thinks of him that way and more because she fears that his actual name would make the strange, uncomfortable wetness worse.
The stares of her inanimate friends apply a level of peer pressure she could not experience anywhere else and beckon her to KILL.
But before one does so, they must have a plan when it comes to burying a body.
They must prepare for the consequences of their temporary high- or the unfortunate falling actions that can only come from the most monumental of climaxes.
With the gun in her hand, she fingers the trigger, aiming the barrel directly at the head of a sleeping giraffe.
But giraffes sleep standing up.
She is biting off more than she can chew.
Tsukasa’s lust has increased to [tsukasa_lust]!
